Implemented the invitation rules from `docs/invitation-rules.md`.

- Invites now store the role in effect when sent, so later org-default changes don’t alter the role granted.
- Expiry is strict: an invite remains usable at `expiresAt` and expires only afterward.
- Token lookup retains each original invite, so re-inviting supersedes old links without reviving revoked ones. Acceptance follows the documented status precedence.
- Email addresses are canonicalized for storage, token generation, identity lookup, acceptance, and revocation; case and `+tag` variants resolve to the same invitee.
- Added regression tests for plus-tag identity, expiry boundaries, and status precedence after re-inviting.

**Verification:** all 14 tests passed when run in one process. `npm test` could not complete because Node’s test runner hit a sandbox `spawn EPERM`; importing the test files directly avoided subprocess spawning.

- All HTTP, database, queue, cache, and webhook plans now resolve timeouts through the shared policy using their full operation names.
- Operation-specific overrides now apply as defaults and request floors; requests are clamped to the 30,000 ms ceiling.
- Invalid requested values, including zero and non-finite values, raise `RangeError`. Overrides for unknown operations are rejected.
- Added tests covering defaults, overrides, clamping, invalid values, and operation-name validation.

**Verification:** All 14 tests passed when run in-process. The standard `npm test` command could not spawn its test worker in this environment (`EPERM`). The dispatch CLI smoke test also confirmed the configured `webhook.deliver` override resolves to 12,000 ms.

function serialize(doc) {
  const lines = []
  pushEntries(lines, doc.globals)
  for (const s of doc.sections) {
    if (lines.length) lines.push('')
    lines.push('[' + s.name + ']')
    pushEntries(lines, s.entries)
  }
  return lines.length ? lines.join('\n') + '\n' : ''
}

function pushEntries(lines, entries) {
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(entries)) {
    lines.push(key + ' = ' + emit(String(value)))
  }
}

function emit(value) {
  const mustQuote = value === '' ||
    /^[ \t]|[ \t]$/.test(value) ||
    /["\n\t]/.test(value) ||
    /[ \t][;#]/.test(value) ||
    value.endsWith('\\')
  return mustQuote ? quote(value) : value
}

function quote(value) {
  return '"' + value
    .replace(/\\/g, '\\\\')
    .replace(/"/g, '\\"')
    .replace(/\n/g, '\\n')
    .replace(/\t/g, '\\t') + '"'
}
